name: Hahót (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of green triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Hahót: a blue and yellow shield with an ox's head, a crozier and a castle wall, above a yellow scroll inscribed HAHÓT.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
